description: This file defines an enumeration XDashStyle that specifies available styles for dashed lines when drawing with an XPen object in the PDFsharp library. The enumeration maps to dash styles like solid, dash, dot, dash-dot, dash-dot-dot, and custom.

classes.name: XDashStyle
classes.description: Enumeration defining dash styles for lines drawn with XPen. Corresponds to system dash styles and includes additional custom style option.
